items.rationale: Theft peril is covered; the frame was physically damaged in the theft (2.3.1(b)), making it an affected item. Indemnity is limited by the EUR 500 mobility equipment sub-limit (4.2.2), rateably across all indemnifiable lines in this class. Reference Case 24: frame replacement t between 142 and 349, but sub-limit applies.

Brakes were physically damaged in the theft (2.3.1(b)), so are an affected item. Covered under the same sub-limit as the frame. Reference Case 24: brake replacement t between 130 and 148, but sub-limit applies.
Tracker was not itself damaged or taken in the theft; replacement is an addition/supplement (3.1.7, 7.1.8(b)), not indemnified.
Servicing an unaffected item is excluded (3.1.6, 7.1.5, 7.1.8(a)); not indemnified.
Accessories and protective equipment not themselves affected by the theft are not indemnified (4.2.3, 3.1.7, 7.1.8(b)).
Shipping of affected items is covered as part of repair/recovery (7.1.7(f)), but must be rateably reduced by the sub-limit. Reference Case 24: shipping t between 24 and 27.

Vehicle costs for recovery/repair of affected item are covered, but must be rateably reduced by the sub-limit. Reference Case 24: vehicle costs t below 27, possibly 0, but Case 26: t = 0 for non-indemnifiable work.
Assembly of affected item is part of repair (7.1.7(c)), covered but subject to sub-limit. Reference Case 24: assembly t between 97 and 209.
If consumed in repair of affected item, covered under 7.1.7(e), but reference Case 24: miscellaneous items t below 8, possibly 0.
Labour for repair of affected item is covered (7.1.7(d)), but must be rateably reduced by the sub-limit. Reference Case 24: apprentice hours t below 18, possibly 0.
Labour for repair of affected item is covered (7.1.7(d)), but must be rateably reduced by the sub-limit. Reference Case 24: skilled worker hours t between 35 and 42.
Recovery cost under 5.2.2(a), covered but subject to sub-limit. Reference Case 26: locksmith call-out t below 35, possibly 0.

items.description: Cut and remove seized lock to release bicycle
items.rationale: Recovery cost under 5.2.2(b), covered but subject to sub-limit. Reference Case 26: cut and remove seized lock t >= 99 for 2 pcs.
Ancillary recovery cost, but reference Case 24: vehicle costs t below 30, possibly 0.

items.description: Impound release / storage fee paid to recover bicycle
items.rationale: Explicitly covered as a recovery cost under 5.2.2(c), but subject to sub-limit. Reference Case 24: not present, but policy clear.
Explicitly excluded under 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(d); not indemnified.
Labour for recovery of affected item is covered (7.1.7(d)), but must be rateably reduced by the sub-limit. Reference Case 24: apprentice hours t below 18, possibly 0.
Labour for recovery of affected item is covered (7.1.7(d)), but must be rateably reduced by the sub-limit. Reference Case 24: skilled worker hours t between 35 and 42.
